answer_4.quote: Two trained annotators independently rate the augmented pairs for the 7 different augmentation strategies ... We define "quality" as the % of examples where the re‑annotated label was the same as the original label and also measure the % of "invalid" examples ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators re‑annotate each augmented response, decide whether the original label is preserved, and mark responses that are semantically incoherent (invalid).
